review:
A savannah 20-liner with animal masks. Mystery Masks reveal a paying symbol or a wild, and if they land on three or more reels, they spread down to the bottom of their reels first.

The Nudge Wild switches on a multiplier wheel at the side that adds a global multiplier to the spin – and it can nudge up to 50 times, climbing each time. Three FS start the Serengeti Sunset bonus. Rated 4/5, 10,000x max, top RTP 96.3%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 88.38% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
